'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economy of Libya]], [[Libyan crisis (2011–present)|Libyan crisis]]

*[[2023 Pacific hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Hilary (2023)|Hurricane Hilary]]
***Hurricane Hilary weakens to [[Saffir–Simpson scale|Category 1]], with warnings and [[emergency evacuation|evacuation]] orders issued as the [[hurricane]] is expected to make landfall in [[Baja California]], [[Mexico]], and [[California]], [[United States]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/US/live-updates/hurricane-hilary/?id=102393064 (ABC News)]
***Hilary makes landfall as a [[tropical storm]] in [[San Quintín Municipality|San Quintín]], Baja California. Flooding is reported in the [[Mexican city]] of [[Tijuana]] and California area of [[Palm Springs, California|Palm Springs]]. Presidential candidates [[Luisa González]] and [[Daniel Noboa]] will face off in a second round vote on 15 October.
